needed.evidence: Visible absence of a footway on the right side of the road, pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Install a designated sidewalk with a physical barrier along the right side of the road to separate pedestrian pathways from vehicle lanes.

needed.evidence: Obstruction on the left side footway due to parked vehicles or stalls.
needed.suggestion: Ensure the left sidewalk is clear of obstructions and maintain sufficient width by restricting parking and erecting barriers where necessary.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the left footway, posing a tripping hazard for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the left footway to eliminate trip hazards and ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: The marked crossing is obstructed and not easily visible to drivers.
needed.suggestion: Install a raised platform or pedestrian refuge at the crossing to enhance visibility and ensure drivers are more likely to stop.
